title: AC1021 TABLE trailing-stream truncation and same-object retry
scope: Add a generated-vector failure/reset/retry control for the classified AutoCAD 2007 AC1021 TABLE parser after the alignment-span implementation.

implementation.vectorSource: The existing makeR2007TableFrame helper authors the AC1021 TABLE body, R2007 string stream, and handle stream in memory. No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
implementation.control: The test gives the parser only the byte prefix through tableDataEndBit, omitting the appended sentinel and trailing object streams. It requires parse refusal, invalidated input, cleared TABLE semantic/model state, then parses the complete frame on the same DRW_Table probe and checks alignment value 6 plus the original body cursor boundary.
implementation.result: Build succeeded; 1 of 1 focused tests passed.

limitations: This is generated-vector parser transaction evidence, not an independent producer witness.
It does not bind additional TABLE fields or graph links, and does not qualify DXF output or readback.
Selected TABLE output remains dependent on the separate P5-B FIELD/FIELDLIST serialization gap.
closure: The AC1021 TABLE generated-vector suite now verifies trailing-stream truncation refusal, state reset, and corrected same-object retry. P5-I remains open; no broader TABLE or AC1021 support claim follows.
